package app

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"math/rand"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

type fastDecoder interface {
	onkDecode(*onkDec)
}

func fastVariants() []reflect.Type {
	return []reflect.Type{
		reflect.TypeOf((*KitchenChoiceText)(nil)), reflect.TypeOf((*KitchenChoiceCount)(nil)),
		reflect.TypeOf((*KitchenChoiceItem)(nil)), reflect.TypeOf((*KitchenChoiceLevel)(nil)),
	}
}

func TestFastPathAcceptsEveryValidDocument(t *testing.T) {
	makers := map[string]func() fastDecoder{
		"Kitchen": func() fastDecoder { return new(Kitchen) },
		"Holder":  func() fastDecoder { return new(Holder) },
		"Tree":    func() fastDecoder { return new(Tree) },
		"Leaf":    func() fastDecoder { return new(Leaf) },
	}
	for name, mk := range makers {
		accepted := 0
		for seed := int64(0); seed < 1500; seed++ {
			f := &filler{rng: rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)), variants: fastVariants()}
			v := mk()
			f.fill(reflect.ValueOf(v).Elem(), 0)
			doc, err := json.Marshal(v)
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}
			var pretty bytes.Buffer
			_ = json.Indent(&pretty, doc, "\t", "  ")
			for _, in := range [][]byte{doc, pretty.Bytes()} {
				d := onkDec{data: in}
				mk().onkDecode(&d)
				if !d.end() {
					t.Fatalf("%s seed %d: the fast path gave up on a valid document (%v):\n%s", name, seed, d.err, in)
				}
				accepted++
			}
		}
		if accepted < 2000 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: only %d documents reached the fast path", name, accepted)
		}
	}
}
